title: VHS
summary: A camcorder for USB cameras: live view, photos and MJPEG movies with sound.
description: Shows the live picture of a USB camera (UVC, MJPEG), the whole frame; with two cameras you choose one and switch on the live view. Takes photos (up to 8 MP, exposure in stops, an autofocus wait) and records movies with sound from the camera's microphone or any sound card (MJPEG with AAC in MKV), lists them as scenes, plays them and copies them to a USB drive. Made for the UGREEN FineCam; the Logitech C270 works too.
depends: libstdc++6, libgcc-s1, libfreetype6, libinput10, libxkbcommon0, libturbojpeg0 | libturbojpeg, libasound2t64 | libasound2, libpulse0, libavformat61 | libavformat62, libavcodec61 | libavcodec62, libavutil59 | libavutil60, libswresample5 | libswresample6
